title: Recording: Loup (1st Indian On The Moon) by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio One, Olympic Studios, London
Producer: Glyn Johns
Engineer: Phil Chapman

Wings finished recording ‘Loup (1st Indian On The Moon)’ for their second album Red Rose Speedway on 17 March 1972.

The song was recorded over three consecutive days at Olympic Studios in Barnes, London, and involved much experimentation with Linda McCartney’s Minimoog Model D synthesizer. The instrumental emerged from a jam with the other members of Wings.
